lessons.text: Never use no true scotsman (Redefining a category on the fly to exclude a damaging counterexample). It cost you against Bjarne Stroustrup.

Prepare an answer before you assert: Bjarne Stroustrup broke through with "But note what just happened: your argument skipped the evidence entirely. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the premise survi…" (Clean argument. structure=0.50, evidence=1.00).

Borrow this pattern from Bjarne Stroustrup: "But note what just happened: your argument skipped the evidence entirely. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the premise survi…" — it carried evidence, its premises led cleanly to the conclusion.

Your weakest move against Bjarne Stroustrup was "However, your premise assumes what it needs to prove, and the data shows otherwise. When the measured results are compared across studies,…" (soundness 0.20). State its premises and evidence before you use it again.
